evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 6 semesters
The tuition fee of the BSc program for two semesters (3,800 Euro) must be paid by bank transfer to the bank account of the university given above.

notes: tuition: the quote is about "the BSc program" in general (the application-procedure page covers the BSc in Computer Science and MSc in Computer Science Engineering); it is not explicitly limited to non-EU/EEA students. intakes: the page states application periods between 1st February and 30th April for the Fall semester without stating the applicants' origin, so it is stored as recurringDeadline only. applicationChannel: no explicit platform (e.g. Stipendium Hungaricum, uni-assist) is named; the page says "You can apply here", so hu-university-direct was used.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée (écrit et oral, en ligne) est requis : vérifiez la procédure et préparez-vous à l'entretien sur vos connaissances en informatique, mathématiques et anglais.
note.en: An entrance exam (written and oral, online) is required: check the procedure and prepare for an interview about your IT, math and English knowledge.

evidence.quote: If you are eligible based on your documents, you will need to take a written and an oral entrance exam.
